description:
The Huffy Axilus 20" BMX Race Bike is designed for riders who want to ride faster, push harder, and take on the track with confidence. Its strong steel BMX frame delivers the durability and responsive feel needed for quick acceleration and smooth control. Whether practicing at the track or racing friends around the neighborhood, the Axilus is built to keep up with every sprint and turn.
A lightweight BMX-style frame paired with a responsive 3-piece crank helps transfer every pedal stroke into forward speed. The single-speed drivetrain keeps riding simple and efficient, while wide BMX tires provide the traction and stability needed for packed dirt tracks or pavement.
Wide BMX handlebars with a crossbar provide strong, confident handling when riders launch off the line or carve through turns. A rear V-brake delivers reliable stopping power, giving riders the control they need to ride fast while staying in command.

components.description: Rear V-Brake Control: Responsive rear V-brake delivers reliable stopping power when it’s time to slow down after the sprint.
